description: This is a Java test class for the PersonValidator component within the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests for validating Person and Patient objects, focusing on fields like birthdate, death date, cause of death, gender, and addresses.

classes.name: PersonValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the PersonValidator's validation logic in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setValidator
methods.description: Sets the Validator instance using dependency injection for testing.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfBirthdateIsAFutureDate
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if a patient's birthdate is set in the future.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDeathDateIsAFutureDate
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if a patient's death date is set in the future.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfBirthdateMakesPatientOlderThat140YearsOld
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the patient's birthdate indicates an age over 140 years.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfCauseOfDeathIsBlankWhenPatientIsDead
methods.description: Tests that causeOfDeath must be set if the patient is marked as dead.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfVoidReasonIsBlankWhenPatientIsVoided
methods.description: Tests that voidReason must be set if the patient is marked as voided.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfPersonDoesNotHaveAtleastOneNonVoidedName
methods.description: Tests that a person must have at least one non-voided name.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfGenderIsBlankForPersons
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when gender is blank.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when field lengths are within acceptable limits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Ensures validation fails when string fields exceed length constraints.

methods.name: shouldNotSetDeathBeforeBirth
methods.description: Validates that death date cannot be before birth date.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationWhenDeathCauseAndDeathCauseNonCodedAreSet
methods.description: Tests that only one of causeOfDeath or causeOfDeathNonCoded should be set.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailWhenDeathCauseNotCodedIsSet
methods.description: Ensures validation passes when cause of death non-coded is set.

methods.name: validate_shouldThrowExceptionWhenAddressIsNull
methods.description: Tests that the validator throws an IllegalArgumentException if an address in addresses set is null.
